ELECTION OF CHAIR AND VICE CHAIR

Chair Pollack declared the nominations open for Chair.

 Vice Chair Coleman nominated Chair Pollack for Chair of the Ethics Commission.

 There being no further nominations, Chair Pollack declared the nominations closed for Chair.

 Chair Pollack spoke.

 Chair Pollack declared the nominations open for Vice Chair.

 Commissioner Wise nominated Vice Chair Coleman for Vice Chair of the Ethics Commission.

 There being no further nominations, Chair Pollack declared the nominations closed for Vice Chair.

 Vice Chair Coleman spoke.

A motion was made by Vice Chair Coleman, to nominate Chair Pollack for Chair of the Ethics
Commission. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  6  Añorve, De Benedictis, Shotwell, Wise, Coleman, Pollack
